text: A voice agent can sound fluent, and still double-book, invent a slot, or lose an emergency. This local demo shows the booking, the handoff, and the audit trail.
Thirty-four synthetic calls. Booking rate, containment, p95 first audio, and two active alerts are on the first screen.
Open a booked call. One booking ID, the exact read-back, the tool timeline, and the measured first audio.
The emergency path runs before the model. A 911-first script, a structured ticket, and a connected transfer. The transfer is simulated in this local demo.
The weekly review turns a sample of calls into scenario candidates, so a failure can become a test.
Both tenants run the same engine. The admin editor validates YAML before it writes.
Local, synthetic, no production SLA. The live audio run is five of six; one ASR miss is shown, not hidden.
Code and evaluation are in the repository.
